item.title: The Minimal Service Layer Pattern
item.description: Problem Link to heading Different people or system need to perform the same operation, and defining an high-impact Service Layer could reduce the reach of requirement. A high-impact Service Layer goes beyond just handling business logic such as filtering authentication and authorization. Consider the following User Stories As a user I want to access to my order (So that I can track my purchase and stay informed about its status)
